name: The Flame's Casing
summary: Kalaran Windblade seeks the last piece for the torch. A large Twilight's Hammer encampment is rumored to lie in the mountains to the northwest, where its people honor their god with symbols and idols. He wants one Symbol of Ragnaros.

sections.title: A Piece for the Casing
sections.body: Kalaran Windblade says the torch needs one last piece. A large Twilight's Hammer encampment is rumored to lie in the mountains to the northwest, with symbols and idols honoring its god. Their enchantment may give the torch a magical casing. Kalaran asks you for one Symbol of Ragnaros, hoping to draw out its magic. Without a suitable source of arcane energy, the torch of retribution cannot be finished.

sections.title: The Symbol Examined
sections.body: The Symbol of Ragnaros gives off a foul magic, just the kind Kalaran needs for his work.

faq.q: What is needed to create the flame's casing?
faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade asks you for one Symbol of Ragnaros, hoping to draw out its magic for the casing.

faq.q: Where is the Twilight's Hammer encampment?
faq.answer: A large Twilight's Hammer encampment is rumored to lie in the mountains to the northwest.

faq.q: Why does Kalaran want a Symbol of Ragnaros?
faq.answer: Twilight's Hammer symbols and idols may carry enough enchantment for a magical casing. Kalaran hopes to draw that magic from one Symbol of Ragnaros.

faq.q: What comes before this step in the chain?
faq.answer: This follows Forging the Shaft, when Kalaran asked for thorium plated daggers to reforge into a shaft.
